fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://www.garphill.com/products/paladins-of-the-west-kingdom. The publisher product page identifies Paladins of the West Kingdom base game; its box art matches this English rule edition. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose the starting player and give them the Start Player Marker. They reveal their Paladin and choose a Tavern card first, then take the first action; play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: The initial Townsfolk recruitment during setup runs in reverse turn order, starting to the right of the chosen first player.
Ignore the marker-passing step in the first round. In later rounds, pass the Start Player Marker clockwise.
